source_issue.title: Add Plone documentation to sites that attract first-time contributors

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue aims to enhance Plone's documentation to attract first-time contributors, inspired by similar efforts in the icalendar project. The initiative is part of a pilot program focused on improving the onboarding experience for new contributors.

## What needs to be done
1. Update the documentation to reflect this pilot program.
2. Analyze the existing first-time contributor guide [here](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/first-time.html) to identify any unwelcoming elements.
3. Consider including low or non-code contributions (e.g., translations, technical writing, graphic design) to broaden participation.

## Helpful background
The project is currently part of Hacktoberfest and has been accepted by Up For Grabs. Ongoing discussions suggest a need for clear guidance on how to improve the documentation for newcomers, especially due to recent changes in Plone's contributions landscape.

## Good first steps
- Review the existing contributor guide and note any confusing or unwelcoming sections.
- Engage with the community by commenting on this issue if you have questions.
- If you're interested in contributing non-code improvements, think about what areas you can help with (like documentation or graphics). 
```
